hook_patterns: High-stakes emotional intrigue (e.g., 'I cried for hours after reading this line')
Direct psychological commands targeting modern habits (e.g., 'Stop doing this immediately')
Name-based wisdom framing targeting a specific demographic or challenge (e.g., 'What [Author] reveals about [Pain Point]')
todays_angle: Extract high-emotion, actionable warnings from classic literature that address modern digital fatigue and interpersonal trust.
ideas: A 30-second breakdown of Dostoyevsky's warning on self-deception, using a bold visual hook about modern social anxiety.
A dramatic reading and modern translation of Seneca's lesson on toxic friendships from 'Letters from a Stoic'.
A fast-paced summary of Oscar Wilde's warning on visual appearances versus character from 'The Picture of Dorian Gray'.
avoid: Generic hashtag-only titles without a clear text hook or emotional trigger.
Overused 'Gym Motivation / Grindset' text overlays that dilute the literary quality of classic texts.
